## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What is missing or frustrating today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like ORION to do? If it is a new tool, describe its inputs and
what it returns.

## Alternatives

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, links, related issues. If this could be a plugin under
`orion/plugins/`, mention it.
